payload.body_they: {{Name}} often notices what people need before anyone has decided whose responsibility it is. They catch when someone is overwhelmed, explain what was confusing, or make the practical adjustment that keeps something working for actual people. That kind of care can become part of what they are known for, but it is easy for everyone to depend on it without naming the time and judgment it requires. If people rely on this part of them, it counts as part of what they contribute.
